entries.title: We’re visiting the Eastern Panhandle — help us plan our trip!
entries.summary: Reporters from Mountain State Spotlight will visit the Eastern Panhandle of West Virginia this fall. Tell them where to go and what to see.
entries.content:
We at Mountain State Spotlight are on a mission to hear from folks from around the state, in the places they call home.

We want to make sure our reporting reflects the readers we serve. And that includes you, your family and your communities.

This fall, we’re going to spend a few days in the Eastern Panhandle — and want to hear from you!

If you live or have connections there, tell us:

What issues are most important to you and your community?

Where do people meet and gather?

What are some other “don’t miss” spots?

Who should we talk to, and how can we reach them?

To share your thoughts, fill out this form:
